verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's structure: logo top-left, badge top-right, headline and subline left-aligned on one edge. Its main flaw is that the shoe slides left off its lime circle instead of sitting centred on it, which looks like a mistake, and the shoe group sits low and heavy. B crowds an oversized logo next to the tilted badge in one top row, so the logo competes with the headline and lines up with neither the headline edge nor the margin. The headline is jammed right under that row, and the shoe and circle are pulled even further apart, leaving the bottom-right overloaded and the bottom-left empty.
